news.t: Cassiem brothers have scored in 13 straight league games
news.s: Dayaan or Mustapha Cassiem has scored in each of Amsterdam's last 13 Hoofdklasse matches.

news.t: Matchday Two round-up: big wins for Wimbledon and Old Georgians
news.s: Wimbledon beat Oxted 6-1 and Old Georgians won 6-1 at Hampstead & Westminster in the men's Premier Division. Wimbledon's women won 6-0.

news.t: Élite round-up: Racing CF lead the men, St Germain and Lille unbeaten in the women's
news.s: Racing Club de France have won all four games and lead the men's Élite on 12 points, with Stade Français second. In the women's, St Germain HC and Lille MHC are the only unbeaten teams.

news.t: Matla reaches 300 official goals for Den Bosch
news.s: Frédérique Matla passes a milestone at Den Bosch. Read the full story for the details.

news.t: Ralph to step down as England and Great Britain women's Head Coach
news.s: England Hockey has announced the coaching change. Read the full story for the details.

news.t: Hockey India League expected back in December 2026 and January 2027
news.s: Hockey India's president says he is confident the league will go ahead, after talks with the sports minister. Dates are not confirmed here.

news.t: FIH Para Hockey World Cup 2026 review
news.s: England Hockey looks back on the tournament.

news.t: Metropolitano playoff places filling up in Buenos Aires
news.s: Italiano beat Ciudad de Buenos Aires 2-0 to reach the women's playoffs, with one spot left. In the men's, San Fernando, Banco Provincia and Ciudad A have qualified.

news.t: Liga IATI round two: 36 goals in six games
news.s: RS Tenis beat UD Taburiente 8-1, while Atlètic Terrassa and CD Terrassa both won 4-3.
The match schedule for the 2027 EuroHockey Championships is out.

news.t: KETTLE named title partner of the EuroHockey Championships 2027
news.s: A new title partner for next year's European championships.
Germany, Spain and England share a men's pool. The Netherlands, Germany and England share a women's pool.

news.t: Germany retain the men's World Cup, Argentina win the women's
news.s: Germany beat Spain 1-0 for a fourth title. Argentina beat the Netherlands in a shoot-out in the women's final.

news.t: Lone Star FHC and Olympic Club win 2026 USFHL national titles
news.s: Lone Star FHC won all five pool games to take the men's national club title for the first time. Olympic Club won the women's title.

news.t: Hockey One 2026 adds an eighth team, the Melbourne Cobras
news.s: HC Melbourne's men are chasing a third straight title when the season starts on 8 October.
